objects.description: During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary instructed Claude Code to use [BACKUPOSINT v9.0 APEX PREDATOR](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9045) to enumerate ports on victim devices and fed it into OpenAI’s GPT-4.1 API for analysis along with other system information.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
